thread:
Sam: Heads up — AO POC billing question from GridHealth. They want a POC credit, clarifying order form fields + KMS clause. Also have MSA/DPA redlines. Need signature routing. @Priya @Nora can you help?

Priya: Thanks. Quick q — can we split the engagement into 'Evaluation' (free credit, 0-90d) and a follow-up 'Pilot' (paid)? I can draft an order form snippet. What peak token volume are they expecting for perf tests?

Sam: They estimated ~200k tokens/day peak during tests. They'd like option to convert to Dedicated after POC if SLA checks out. Procurement also asked about key custody — they want HSM/KMS integration in Private.

Priya: For billing credits we usually put a one-time credit line on the order form and net it against the first invoice. Example snippet: 
```
Item: POC credits
Qty: 1
Amount: $15,000 (one-time credit)
Billing: applied to first invoice
```
Would that work for them?

Taylor: Ops note — for one-time credit we need a PO + billing contact + remit instructions. If they convert to Reserved Dedicated we'll need committed usage numbers for pricing. Please request PO # and payment terms from procurement.

Sam: Procurement sent redlines: data residency clause, DPA subprocessor language, and they want SLA = 99.95 for Dedicated. Also asked for KMS integration language in MSA. Nora — can legal advise on these redlines?

Nora: Received the redlines. Main items: (1) explicit data residency & subprocessor disclosure, (2) indemnity carveouts they added, (3) KMS/HSM liability language. For the DPA we can offer SCCs for EU customers. SLA 99.95 for Dedicated is negotiable but needs a concrete penalty schedule and a pricing delta. Sales Ops, can you confirm the cost impact?

Maya: Security input — we can support AWS KMS and customer-managed HSM for Private deployments. Key import and lifecycle management must be customer responsibility. We'll provide standard KMS integration language to include in the DPA/MSA. Also need network/contact details for any on-prem setup.

Sam: @Taylor can you set up DocuSign routing? Customer expects procurement -> legal -> sysadmin sign flow.

Taylor: Routing plan: procurement -> legal -> exec. Sysadmin can be set as required or cc depending on their preference. Need exact emails and the PO to attach. I'll also flag payment terms.

Sam: Emails: procurement: po@gridhealth.com, legal: legal@gridhealth.com, sysadmin: infra@gridhealth.com. Uploading redlines to thread now.

Nora: Please send the redlines PDF to legal-review@redwood.com. We'll do a consolidated counter-redline and aim for a 24hr turnaround.

Sam: Upload: `gridhealth_poc_redlines_v1.pdf` (uploaded). Also procurement asked whether the credit expires — they want to know time window.

Priya: Standard POC credits expire in 120 days. We can be flexible for enterprise deals; propose 120 days for this one.

Taylor: Action items: Sam — secure PO + confirm signers; Priya — send completed order form snippet and pricing delta if SLA changes; Nora — prepare consolidated redline + alternative indemnity language; Maya — provide KMS/HSM clause. I'll queue DocuSign once PO + emails + final order form are in.

Nora: I'll produce consolidated redline and aim to circulate by tomorrow EOD.

deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope template created: ds-env-14287 (placeholder)

Sam: Thanks all — I'll chase procurement now and post updates here.
